mapper.update: update conversation set unread_count_user1 = case when user1_id = #{userId} and id = #{conversationId} then 0 else unread_count_user1 end, unread_count_user2 = case when user2_id = #{userId} and id = #{conversationId} then 0 else unread_count_user2 end where (user1_id = #{userId} or user2_id = #{userId}) and id = #{conversationId}

UPDATE conversation SET unread_count_user1 = unread_count_user1 + CASE WHEN user1_id = #{receiverId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, unread_count_user2 = unread_count_user2 + CASE WHEN user2_id = #{receiverId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = #{conversationId}
UPDATE `group` SET member_count = member_count + #{size},updated_time = now() WHERE id = #{groupId} and member_count + #{size} < 50
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum( case when user1_id = #{userId} then unread_count_user1 else unread_count_user2 end ), 0) as totalUnread from conversation where user1_id = #{userId} or user2_id = #{userId}
select gu.group_id as groupId, gu.user_id as userId, gu.role as role, gu.unread_count as unreadCount from group_user gu where gu.user_id = #{userId}
select coalesce(sum(gu.unread_count), 0) as totalUnread from group_user gu where gu.user_id = #{userId}

select gm.id as messageId, gm.group_id as groupId, gm.sender_id as senderId, gm.content as content, gm.type as type, gm.is_recalled as isRecalled, gm.created_time as createdTime from `group_message` gm where gm.group_id = #{groupId} order by gm.created_time asc limit #{limit}
